verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer portal documents test accounts for building and testing custom integrations and apps without risking the production account [klaviyo-docs-4]. These accounts can be populated with sample data [klaviyo-docs-5] and exercised through a pre-built Postman collection [klaviyo-docs-6], which covers the core of isolated testing away from production data. missing for 10: details on how test accounts are provisioned and how they are limited, explicit evidence that API keys, OAuth apps or the MCP server can be pointed at a test account for agent-driven testing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
